title: Wubansia kit
description: A kit for the groove core's generator (core/gen/content.cpp reads it, with the same rules and more: every lane of the kit's style needs an entry here, every drum voice of the style a note, and so on). Integers and strings only: the generator has no floating point (docs/plans/S1-futuristic-slice.md 4.2). Write integers without a fraction or exponent: the C++ reader refuses 134.0, but JSON Schema counts 134.0 as the integer 134, so this schema alone cannot. The file name is the id lowercased: FUT01 is content/kits/fut01.json.

name.description: A plain-words working name: no artist names (CLAUDE.md).

mode.description: The generator writes minor keys, in their natural-minor key signature.

name.description: Must match the tonic, spelled as the legacy pack spells keys.

camelot.description: Must match the key: F# minor is 11A.

swing.description: The groove's base swing in permille: where the second 16th of each 8th lands, as a share of the 8th (500 straight). The feel's lane swings are relative to it.

lanes.description: One entry per lane of the style, keyed by the lane's id. Drum lanes name a GM note for each of the style's voices; pitched lanes give their register.

channel.description: Counted from 0: drum lanes are on 9 (GM channel 10).

notes.description: Drum lanes: voice id to GM note. Exported drums and perc stay inside 35-59 (plan 2.6), so a drag back onto Wubansia plays drums.

range.description: Pitched lanes: the lowest and highest MIDI note, low to high, at least an octave apart.

root.description: The bass lane: the tonic in the bass register (its lowest root), inside the range.
